page.overview:
Who is Great King of South Hill?

The was a demon who resided on Hidden Mist Mountain, Folded Mountain.

In his true form, the Great King of South Hill is a leopard with mugwort-like spots.

The Great King of South Hill was attacked by Zhu Bajie when the pilgrims were travelling through the area, who managed to successfully force him to retreat. After being informed by his servants of the pilgrim’s nature, the Great King of South Hill had three of his servants impersonate him to lure away the three disciples so he could kidnap Tang Sanzang unopposed.

When the pilgrims came to Folded Mountain looking for him, the Great King sent out the skull of another traveller they'd killed and pretended that Tang Sanzang had already been eaten. Sun Wukong eventually discovered the truth and put all the demons to sleep with sleep-bugs, then set the cave on fire. Zhu Bajie then killed the Great King in a single hit.
